rations-only.label: Eleven rations, nothing else to store or sell
rations-only.explanation: Original: turn 1 stores 3 rations (newest history entry, not checked); turns 2 and 3 take a ration back out each time (step 4, buy useful things from the home) until the pack holds ten. Corrected: turn 1 stores 3 rations, turn 2 sees them in the history and leaves.

with-recall.label: Control: the stored rations are not the newest entry
with-recall.explanation: Turn 1 stores 3 rations, turn 2 stores the Word of Recall scroll, so the rations are the older entry, which both versions check. Neither takes anything back; the logs are identical.
